name: X (Twitter)

Software Engineer.dsaDepth: Moderate–Heavy — a phone screen then 4-5 onsite rounds mixing coding, system design and behavioral, with interviewers reported to care as much about process and communication as the final answer
rounds: Onsite/virtual loop (4-5 rounds): 2 coding rounds (LeetCode easy-medium, data structures and algorithms), 1 system design round, 1 behavioral/hiring-manager round
STAR-method behavioral preparation is explicitly recommended by multiple candidates
extraTopics: How you work through a problem and communicate your reasoning — several candidates note Twitter/X evaluates process and collaboration more than most companies, not just whether you reach the right answer
Being ready for both "tell me about yourself" and "why Twitter/X" in the same behavioral round
Software Engineer.notes: Post-acquisition (X) reports show broadly the same structure as pre-2023 Twitter reports, suggesting the loop has stayed fairly stable through the ownership change.
